**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is trying to get a better grip on their eating habits and cooking routines.  
[EVENT] User started using a food delivery app called "Bites" three weeks ago.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant recommended several apps for tracking food expenses: Mint, Personal Capital, You Need a Budget (YNAB), Spendee, and Food Diary.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple spreadsheet template for tracking food expenses with columns for Date, Category, Item, and Cost.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant emphasized the importance of consistency and honesty in tracking food expenses.  
[CHANGE] User decided to start with a simple spreadsheet for tracking food expenses.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an updated template for tracking food expenses, including columns for Location and Type.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested categories for the "Category" column: Groceries, Dining Out, Takeout/Delivery, Snacks, Coffee/Breakfast, and Subscriptions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained the purpose of each column in the template.  
[CHANGE] User decided to add a column for "Cooking Method" to track whether they cooked at home, ordered in, or ate out.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an updated template including the "Cooking Method" column and suggested options for it.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an updated template including the "Recipe" column and explained how to use it.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an updated template including the "Meal Prep" column and suggested what to track in it.
